data.description: Stylish Furnished Unit | Park View | Best Price
data.display_address: Ghalia, District 18, Jumeirah Village Circle, Dubai
data.long_description:
Discover modern and comfortable living in this fully furnished studio apartment, ideally located in a vibrant and well-connected community. Spanning 448.96 Sqft, this thoughtfully designed unit offers a smart layout that maximizes space and natural light, complemented by a relaxing park view.

Perfect for tenants seeking convenience and style, the apartment features contemporary finishes and a functional layout, creating a cozy yet practical living space at excellent value.

Property Highlights:

Fully furnished studio with efficient layout
Bright living/sleeping area with large windows
Modern open kitchen with fitted cabinets and appliances
Built-in wardrobes for optimal storage
Stylish bathroom with quality fittings
Private balcony with peaceful park views
Premium tile flooring throughout
Central air conditioning
Covered parking space

Building & Community Features:

24/7 security and concierge
High-speed elevators
Temperature-controlled swimming pool
Fully equipped gym
Landscaped leisure areas
Family-friendly community
Walking distance to JVC Community Park
Close to supermarkets, cafés, and retail outlets
Easy access to Al Khail Road & Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road
Minutes from Circle Mall

Offered at a competitive rental price, this unit is an excellent choice for individuals looking for a move-in ready home in a prime location with strong lifestyle appeal.
